exposure: environmental and logistical aspects of delivery wards
outcome: Location of early skin-to-skin contact (delivery room, operating theater, postpartum room)
cohort: Delivery wards in Piedmont and the Aosta Valley, Italy
finding: The survey found changes in the organization of early skin-to-skin contact practices in delivery wards in Piedmont and the Aosta Valley between 2012 and 2016, suggesting improvements in the implementation of safe early skin-to-skin contact.
mod_finding: The survey found an increase in the number of delivery wards offering early skin-to-skin contact in the operating theater following caesarean sections, from 11/26 in 2012 to 11/28 in 2016.
